name: Palelight
description: A lone white dwarf ember keeping a frozen world and a single dwarf planet in its faint warmth. The system died once already when the primary swelled and died. What orbits now is what refused to leave.

stars.name: Palelight Cinder
stars.description: A Earth-sized ember cooling through white toward eventual black, fierce and tiny. Its planets huddle closer than Mercury ever dared. The light is blue, hard, and honest.

planets.name: Palefrost
planets.description: A nitrogen-glacier world in the ember's narrow warmth, geysers erupting along the terminator. The sky holds a permanent blue-white noon that never warms the ground. Subsurface lakes glimmer on deep radar.

dwarfPlanets.name: Cinder Minor
dwarfPlanets.description: A dark ice dwarf far outside the ember's reach, unchanged since the giant's death. Its craters hold pre-nova chemistry like pressed flowers. Samplers brave the cold for primordial volatiles.
